items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I made that with Fats -- it was 'Memphis Blues'

ctx.x: They were? And that was in February of '27. Then in May of '27 you did three sides with Fats Waller on the pipe organ, which you did in Camden. Do you remember that?
Uh-huh, I made that with Fats -- it was 'Memphis Blues' --
